notes.title: Trap Master 1.0 is Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Trap Masters,

We're thrilled to announce the full release of CD2: Trap Master! During Early Access, we got valueable feedback and pushed lots of patches and new content. This 1.0 version is also packed with new content that both new and old players will enjoy!

🕹️New Class & New Deck🕹️

The 1.0 version has the new class [Book of Tengu], independent of the original [Demon's Bible]. The two books come with two completely different starting decks. Players will experience a new Elements deck with more strategic options and depth. Both new and old players will enjoy the challenges in this fantasy world.

🎯53 New Cards, 13 New Inscriptions, 6 New Treasure, 5 New Bosses!🎯

Summon an assortment of natural elemental totems and place them on the field to boost the traps with powerful energy. These mysterious totems carry the power of natural elements such as earth, lightning, ice and demons, and become a powerful defense that cannot be ignored.
There are also various mass attack traps that can quickly and powerfully repel the enemy hordes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43711502/867a27c4d5a43920e4af7fb95bc9eb0512160059.jpg

🐲Take over [Book of Tengu]🐲

The only summoner on the continent who can perfectly blend the power of nature with the power of the magic dragon. Manipulating the majestic energy of the earth and the magic dragons, he has become a new favorite in the realm of illusions with his exceptional shamanic skills.
Gain the transformative power of the forces of nature. Unleash the fury of the earth to crack mountains; turn snow into ice to block your enemies. This versatility makes you an unpredictable, inescapable threat. Harness this power, rewrite the battlefield and conquer the unknown realm of illusion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43711502/9f588cb895c858ad892a49563cf176abc9257269.jpg

🐸Die in the Dungeon Crossover🐸

Yes crossover with Die in the Dungeon! Don't be surprised if you come across some froggy cards and treasure in the full game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43711502/6c1002136136a94974745e15a312b22c9cfd0452.jpg

📈Gameplay Improvement📈

Based on the feedback we received from players in the EA version, we have made balance adjustments to the game, and each change has been carefully designed to bring you a fair and challenging game experience.

1. Increase the base blood level of books, and increase the damage that desert and snow monsters can generate.
2. Monster collision label optimization
3. Derivative upgrades do not affect costs
4. Boss blood bar, rest phase slow recovery, reflect progress bar
5. Summoning unit summoning optimization tips
6. All nodes add animations
7. In-game discard animation
8. Add in-game effects to change cards
9. Add buff display for traps on the field.
10. Add drop-down hide button to in-game card selection screen.

🐛Bugfix🐛

1. Trap airborne tag
2. Game stuck at drawing cards
3. Minimum cost is still 0 even after increasing the cost of darts
4. Game crashes
5. Some upgraded cards remain unchanged
6. After returning to the home screen and clicking Continue Game, the deck changes to the initial deck.
7. Optimization of gallery display
8. Monster accidental death bug

If you enjoy the game, please don't hesitate to leave us a review🙏 It would be great help to us! If you have any suggestions or feedback, please let us know on Steam or talk to us on Discord! 
Your feedback matters a lot to us!

Enjoy!
ACE

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello trap masters! 

After a period of hard work, we're happy to report that a new update is now live!

We've made a number of optimisations and added new features to the game, here are the details of the update:


 1. Treasure System: Holding treasure will not only increase your combat power, but will also add a lot of fun to your adventures.
 2. Card Interaction Optimisation: We have optimised the interaction of using cards to make the experience smoother.
 3. Map node generation algorithm optimisation: This update has adjusted the map node generation algorithm, so that the distribution of different types of events on the map will be more reasonable.
 4. Homescreen update: We moved the homescreen to a brand new scene, and we believe you will like this new experience.
 5. BUG FIX: We have fixed some previously existing bugs to ensure the game flow can go more smoothly.


🔴Important Note🔴
For players who already have a gamesave, we recommend that you click Start New Game. If you choose to continue the game, it may result in a poor gaming experience due to issues with the map. In this case, it is still recommended that you restart a new game for the best gaming experience (previously acquired demon cards are unaffected and can still be used normally)

Thank you for your support and understanding, and we hope you enjoy this update. We will continue to work hard to bring you more quality content!

Last but not least, have a great weekend!
Free prologue will be available soon, follow and add wishlist to be the first to experience it!

notes.title: Looking for Alpha Testers - JOIN CLOSED BETA :)
notes.content:
Dear trap masters,

Trap Master's first demo will be ready soon, and we are looking for alpha testers! 
We want to combine tower defense designs and roguelike deckbuilding gameplay to deliver a refreshing game experience. Your support and feedback will be tremendously helpful!

How to Take Part in Alpha Test?
[olist]
 Please sign up by filling out this form
 Selected testers will receive Steam keys via email by 09:00 April 14 (GMT+00:00)
 Launch your Steam client and activate the game with the key!
 The test will lasts for 3 days: 09:00 April 14 - 09:00 April 17 (GMT+00:00)
[/olist]

Content of the Demo
In this demo, you will be able to learn the basics of the game in a roguelike map, where you can get familiar with the main mechanics of the game: build a deck, play the cards to lay down traps and launch attacks to win tower-defense combats, and make the most of mysterious encounters on the way.

Your Feedback Means A LOT!
This is the first demo so bugs or other issues are possible. We call for your understanding and patience. We're hoping to gather feedback primarily on gameplay, and many of the in-game art assets are only temporary.

Tell us what you think via the in-game survey, or join our Discord server to get in touch with the team!

Thank you!
ACE
